name: io.github.voyageurworks/handoff-desk
title: handoff-desk
description: Hand tasks from Claude Code, Cursor or Codex to a personal agent through a folder of markdown notes.

environmentVariables.name: HANDOFF_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder that holds the desk (the markdown notes). Defaults to a folder named handoff in your home directory.

environmentVariables.name: HANDOFF_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional Telegram doorbell: the bot's token (or use HANDOFF_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN_COMMAND).

environmentVariables.name: HANDOFF_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional Telegram doorbell: the chat the bot writes to.

environmentVariables.name: HANDOFF_SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional Slack doorbell: an incoming-webhook URL (or use HANDOFF_SLACK_WEBHOOK_COMMAND).

environmentVariables.name: HANDOFF_NOTIFY_INCLUDE_REQUEST
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to add a shortened request to Telegram and Slack messages. Off by default.
